name: Phone Input
description: A country calling-code dropdown paired with a national number field that emits an E.164-ish string.

anatomy.description: A select of curated calling codes with its own accessible name, preceding the number field in tab order.
A type=tel input that strips non-digits and emits +dial plus national number on every edit.
The visible label, associated with the number field.
Optional description or validation message linked with aria-describedby.

dos: Store the emitted E.164-ish string so numbers stay normalized across regions.
Prefill existing values; the component parses them back into country and number.
Validate the final number on submit; the field only normalizes shape.
donts: Don't use it for domestic-only entry; a MaskedInput with the national format is less UI.
Don't split the value yourself; read the combined string from onChange.

examples.title: Basic entry
examples.description: A curated calling-code list keeps the dropdown short while covering the most common regions.

examples.title: Prefilled international number
examples.description: An existing E.164-ish value is parsed back into the right country and national number.

guidance.useWhen: You collect phone numbers that must be stored in a normalized international form, such as contact or billing profiles.
guidance.avoidWhen: The number is always domestic; a MaskedInput with a national format is less UI. For free-form contact info use a plain Input.
guidance.behavior: Emits +<dial><digits> on every edit and undefined when the number is emptied; non-digit characters are stripped from the national number.
guidance.responsive: The country dropdown keeps its natural width while the number field flexes to fill the remaining space.

notes: The country dropdown has its own accessible name, "Country calling code".
The visible label points at the number field; the dropdown precedes it in the tab order.
type="tel" summons a telephone keypad on touch devices.
